watchOut: The hourly table is labeled as estimates. Compare the written all-in quote, not the table, against other providers.
Until October 2026 this page published a lower table ($4,000 to $18,500 an hour) and itemized fee ranges; both were replaced.
feesNamed: Landing fees (included in the all-in quote)
Catering, ground transportation and de-icing (quoted separately)
name: Stratos Jets
roleBasis: Its homepage calls it an "ARGUS-Certified Broker" and describes "brokering on-demand charter flights".
summary: Charter broker with an eight-row hourly table and quotes it describes as all-in.
differentiator: Its hourly table runs from $5,648 for very light jets to $22,910 for ultra long range, and it says every quote is all-in: charter rate, crew, landing, ramp and handling fees, federal excise tax and segment fees, with catering, ground transport and de-icing quoted separately. It calls the table itself estimates and does not say whether those hourly figures include the fees.
priceNote: The page contrasts jet cards, which it says need prepaid deposits of $100K to $500K+, with paying market rates per trip and no upfront commitment.
operatorDisclosure: Says it runs an ARGUS CHEQ report on the aircraft before presenting a quote. The pages we read do not say whether the operator is named.
bestFor: Buyers who want one all-in quote and a clear list of what it includes.
skipIf: You are using its table as a base rate to compare against other base-rate tables. The basis of the table is not stated.
